text: The authors follow Burns et al. (2024) in defining weak and strong models by size, using 4 weak models (1-3B parameters) and 3 strong models (7-9B) for 12 model pairs, and 15 of Burns et al.'s binary classification NLP tasks. They measure similarity between the weak supervisor and the base student model on the validation set before weak-to-strong training with the confidence-weighted finetuning objective.
title: The authors reuse Burns et al.'s weak-to-strong setup and add supervisor-student similarity
